log.cunningRegen: {name}'s hands find their rhythm — a Cunning Action returns.
log.wildShapeFade: {name} lets the beast's shape fall away.
log.vitalityTick: The vitality draught knits {amount} HP into {name}.{suffix}
log.cursedGround: The cursed ground bites {name} for {chip} damage.
log.paralyzeStruggle: {name} struggles against paralysis. {abil} save{adv}: d20{mod} = {total} vs DC {dc} — {result}.
log.paralyzeBreakFree: {name} breaks free. The Magistrate's hold falls away.
log.paralyzeWearsThin: The binding wears thin and snaps. {name} can move again.
log.paralyzeCannotMove: {name} cannot move. The turn is lost.
log.offenseFighter: {name} commits to a {offense} — this turn's strikes land surer (+{hit} to hit) and bite for {dmg} more.
log.offenseOther: {name} commits to a {offense} — this turn's strikes bite for {dmg} more.
log.defense: {name} sets a {defense} — the next blow is blunted by {reduction}.
log.disrupt: {name} winds up a {disrupt} — the next blow must land to stagger its mark.
log.rageBlockedArmor: {name} reaches for the fury, but the heavy plate smothers it — no rage takes hold until the armor comes off.
log.rageEnter: {name} gives way to the fury — physical blows glance off and every swing bites deeper, but no mending until it passes. {rounds} rounds.
log.actionSurge: {name} surges — adrenaline burns through the wound. One more swing.
log.cunningHide: {name} slips into a shadow. Next strike lands with advantage.
log.cunningFeint: {name} feints high — the guard drops. The next strike finds the gap.
log.cunningSteel: {name} steels their nerve — the soul braces for the strike. Advantage on the next save.
log.cunningQuick: {name} surges forward — a second quick strike rides the momentum.
log.huntersMark: {name} marks {target} as the quarry. Every arrow that finds it bites the deeper.
log.flurry: {name} pours Ki into a flurry — {strikes} more strikes fall before the foe can answer.
log.patientDefense: {name} settles into a flowing guard — the next blows come at disadvantage.
log.stunningStrike: {name} gathers Ki behind the next strike — aiming to drop a foe where it stands.
log.wildShape: {name} sheds the body for a beast's shape — {temp} temporary HP and claws to bare, until the form spends out or fades.
log.useItemVitality: A slow vitality settles in — about {perTurn} HP at the start of each of the next {turns} turns.
log.useItemAntitoxin: The phial empties cold — poison will slide off until the room falls silent.
log.wardHold: The wards hold — {name} shrugs off the blow ({label}).
log.disengage: {name} twists with the blow — {reduction} damage avoided.
log.evasion: {name} reads the wind-up and rolls clear — Evasion halves the blast ({from} → {to}).
log.stabilise: {name} is on death's door — Ilmater's grip holds. Stabilised at 1 HP.
log.mendKindled: {name} feels the wound mend — regen kindled ({n} HP/turn × 3).
log.maneuverWound: {target} reels from the maneuver — a wound opens (3/turn).
log.staggered: {target} is staggered — it will lose its next turn.
log.stunSaveRoll: {target} reels from the strike — CON save{resolute}: d20{mod} = {total} vs DC {dc} — {result}.
log.stunned: {target} is stunned — it will lose its next turn.
log.disruptWide: {name}'s staggering strike goes wide — the opening is lost.
log.telegraphCharge: {name} draws itself up, channeling {action} — a devastating blow lands next turn.
log.chargeCollapse: {name} loses focus — the building {action} collapses, uncast.
log.knockedDown: {name} is knocked down — the turn is lost.
log.paralyzedLost: {name} is paralyzed — the turn is lost.
log.rootedFree: {name} wrenches free of the grasping roots — the turn is lost.
log.rootedHeld: {name} is held fast by roots — the turn is lost.
log.bossSecondWind: {name} refuses to fall — a furious second wind drives it to strike again.
log.battleRage: {name} enters Battle Rage — +2 damage per hit.
log.nimbleTwist: {name} twists low under the opening swing.
log.mirrorSawThrough: {attacker} sees past the flicker and strikes the true {name} — a duplicate collapses all the same.{remain}
log.mirrorShatter: A flickering duplicate shatters — the blow finds only afterimage.{remain}
log.paralyzeApplied: {name} is paralyzed. The Magistrate's hold tightens.
log.blur: {name}'s outline smears into a doubled blur — for {rounds} rounds, attackers strike at disadvantage.
log.burningHands: {name} hurls a cone of flame. {rolls}{bonus} = {dmg} fire{evoker}. DEX save DC {dc} for half.
log.entangleCast: {name} calls grasping roots up through the floor — every foe must make a Strength save vs DC {dc} or be rooted fast.
log.entangleRootedOne: {names} is caught fast — the roots hold, and the next turn is lost.
log.entangleRootedMany: {names} are caught fast — the roots hold, and the next turn is lost.
log.fireballCast: {name} flicks an ember — it blooms into a roar of flame. {rolls} = {dmg} fire{evoker}. DEX save DC {dc} for half; failures ignite.
log.fireballIgniteOne: {names} ignites — burning for {dmg} fire next turn.
log.fireballIgniteMany: {names} ignite — burning for {dmg} fire next turn.

log.forceLance: {name} drives a Force Lance through {target} — {dealt} force, unerring.
log.voidRayRoll: {name} bores a Void Ray at {target}. d20{mod} = {total} vs AC {ac} — {result}.
log.voidRayHit: The wound refuses to close — {dealt} necrotic.
log.halfApart: {name} speaks {target} half-apart. CON save: d20{mod} = {total} vs DC {dc} — {result}.
log.wither: {name} withers {target} — {dealt} necrotic, and the strength sloughs from its limbs.
log.soulSnareRoll: {name} casts Soul Snare at {target}. WIS save{resolute}: d20{mod} = {total} vs DC {dc} — {result}.
log.soulSnareBound: {target} locks rigid — bound body and will for 3 rounds.
log.holdPersonRoll: {name} weaves {spell} at {target}. WIS save{resolute}: d20{mod} = {total} vs DC {dc} — {result}.
log.lifeDrainRestore: The stolen life floods back into {name} — {amount} HP restored.
log.vampiricTouch: {caster} lays a grave-cold hand on {target} — {dealt} necrotic, the warmth dragged out of it.
log.exsanguinate: {caster} bleeds {target} dry from across the room — {dealt} necrotic torn loose.
log.lightningBolt: {name} looses a spear of lightning at {target}. {rolls} = {dmg} lightning{evoker}. DEX save DC {dc} for half{fork}.
log.lightningForkClause: ; the bolt forks to a second for half
log.lightningForkRoll: The bolt forks to {name}. DEX save: d20{mod} = {total} vs DC {dc} — {result}.
log.mageArmor: {name} wraps themselves in shimmering force — +3 AC for this fight.
log.mirrorImage: {name} splits into {count} flickering duplicates — each will take a blow meant for you.
log.mistyStep: {name} steps through a curl of silver mist — +2 AC until next turn. The world reshapes around you; the next blow finds you elsewhere. Advantage on the next save.
log.apotheosis: {name} sheds the limits of flesh and blazes as something greater — {temp} temp HP, +{ac} AC, and every strike biting deeper for {rounds} rounds.
log.timeStop: {name} stops time — the world freezes mid-breath. {turns} free turns before any foe can so much as flinch.
log.timeStopTurn: Time hangs frozen — {name} moves again while the world holds still. ({n} frozen turns left)
log.shapeChange: {name}'s body swells and scales over into a dragon — {temp} temp HP and three rending claws, for {rounds} rounds.
log.shapeChangeFade: The dragon's shape sloughs away — {name} is flesh again.
log.ninthDrain: {name} speaks {target} half-out of the world — {dealt} necrotic as its form buckles.
log.ninthBindRoll: {name} CON save vs the binding{resolute}: d20{mod} = {total} vs DC {dc} — {result}.
log.ninthBindParalyze: {name} is remade into something helpless — paralyzed for 2 rounds.
log.regrowth: Green life wells up through {name} — {amount} HP knit, and {perTurn} more at the start of each of the next {ticks} turns.
log.scorchingRayMiss: Every ray goes wide — {target} is untouched.
log.shieldCast: {name} snaps a wall of force into place — +5 AC until next turn.
log.shieldReact: {name} reacts with Shield — AC {ac} → {newAc}, the blow glances off (−1 L1 slot).
log.spiritBeastCast: {name} calls a spirit beast to their side — fang and claw given form. It will maul a foe at the start of each of the next {ticks} turns.
log.openingVolley: {name} looses an opening volley before the enemy can close.

cunning.title: Cunning Action
cunning.footer: Spend freely — a used Cunning Action returns every couple of turns.
cunning.hideBlurb: Slip into the shadow. Your next attack rolls with advantage — and finds the gap for Sneak Attack.
cunning.quickStrikeBlurb: Surge forward — take a second weapon strike this turn. Carries Sneak Attack only if the first strike hasn’t already spent it.
cunning.feintBlurb: Bait the guard open. Your next strike lands Sneak Attack with no setup — no advantage, wound, or dagger needed.
cunning.steelBlurb: Brace your mind. Advantage on your next saving throw.

intent.drain: Life-drain for {dmg} damage — it heals for part of what it deals.

hud.label: Combat HUD
hud.critTitle: Critical range: a natural {range} on the d20 scores a critical hit (doubled damage dice).
hud.poolReady: {pool} to spend — fuels {offense}, {defense}, {disrupt}. Refreshes each fight, regenerates through it.
hud.offenseSet: {offense} set — this turn's strikes land for bonus damage.
hud.disruptArmed: {disrupt} armed — the next hit staggers its target.
hud.kiReady: Ki to spend — fuels Flurry of Blows, Patient Defense, and Stunning Strike. The well refills as each fight begins.
hud.cunningRegenOne: A spent Cunning Action returns in {n} turn — the rogue claws one use back every couple of turns.
hud.cunningRegenMany: A spent Cunning Action returns in {n} turns — the rogue claws one use back every couple of turns.
hud.sneakUsedTitle: Sneak Attack already fired this turn.
hud.sneakAdvTitle: Sneak Attack will trigger — you have advantage on your next attack.
hud.sneakBloodiedTitle: Sneak Attack will trigger — a target is bloodied.
hud.sneakNeedTitle: Sneak Attack needs advantage (Hide) or a bloodied target.
hud.udReadyTitle: Uncanny Dodge: halves the first hit you take this round.
hud.udUsedTitle: Uncanny Dodge already used this round — resets at end of turn.
hud.nimbleReadyTitle: Nimble Dodge: the first attack against you this round is made at disadvantage.
hud.nimbleUsedTitle: Nimble Dodge already used this round — resets at end of turn.
hud.shieldOnTitle: Shield auto-fires when it would turn a hit into a miss (costs 1 L1 slot). Click to disable.
hud.shieldOffTitle: Shield auto-fire is OFF — the slot is never spent automatically. Click to enable.
hud.rageUnlimitedTitle: Primal Champion — Rage is bottomless. Enter the fury as often as you like; it never spends a charge.
hud.rageChargeReady: Rage charge ready — a 5-round fury. Charges refill only at a rest, not between fights.
hud.rageChargeSpent: Rage charge spent — refills at the next rest.
hud.ragingTitleOne: Raging — {n} round left. Physical damage halved, melee hits land harder. Healing locked out until fury ends.
hud.ragingTitleMany: Raging — {n} rounds left. Physical damage halved, melee hits land harder. Healing locked out until fury ends.
hud.recklessTitle: Raging recklessly — your melee attacks have advantage, and so do attacks against you, for as long as the fury holds.
hud.quarryTitle: Hunter's Mark rides {name} — every hit on it bites deeper.
hud.quarryNoneTitle: No quarry marked — Hunter's Mark adds bonus damage to a branded target.
hud.spellDcTitle: Spell save DC enemies roll against
hud.mageArmorDesc: Mage Armor — base AC becomes 13 + DEX while unarmored.
hud.shieldDesc: Shield — +5 AC against incoming attacks until your next turn.
hud.mistyStepDesc: Misty Step — +2 AC until your next turn.

bar.secondWind: Bonus action: heal 1d10 + 2 per level. Once per combat.
bar.actionSurge: Free Action: regain your action this turn. Once per short rest.
bar.offenseFighter: Costs {cost} {pool}: this turn's strikes land surer (+{hit} to hit) and bite for +{dmg} damage{cleave}.
bar.offenseOther: Costs {cost} {pool}: this turn's strikes land for +{dmg} damage{cleave}.
bar.offenseCleave: , and cleave into a second foe
bar.bonusActionCost: Also spends your bonus action this turn.
bar.defense: Costs {cost} {pool}: blunt the next hit you take by {reduction}. Hold it for a blow you can see coming.
bar.disrupt: Costs {cost} {pool}: arm a staggering strike — the next hit fells its target and costs it its next turn.
bar.cunningAction: Bonus action: Hide (advantage on next attack — enables Sneak), Quick Strike (a second strike this turn), Feint (guarantee Sneak on your next strike), or Steel Yourself (advantage on next save).
bar.rageArmor: Heavy armor smothers your Rage — remove the plate to call the fury.
bar.rageEmpty: Out of Rage charges — rest at a camp to refill them.
bar.rage: Bonus action: enter a {rounds}-round battle-fury — physical damage halved, melee hits deal bonus damage, but healing is locked out until the fury ends. Spends one Rage charge; charges refill only at a rest.
bar.huntersMark: Bonus action: brand a target as your quarry — every hit on it deals extra damage. Re-cast to move the mark.
bar.flurry: Bonus action, 1 Ki: rain extra unarmed strikes this turn — keep hitting after your Attack action is spent.
bar.patientDefense: Bonus action, 1 Ki: flow into a yielding guard — attacks against you roll at disadvantage until your next turn.
bar.stunningStrike: Free, 2 Ki: arm a staggering blow — your next unarmed hit forces a save or the target loses its next turn.
bar.wildShapeOn: Already wearing the beast — claws out until the form spends out or fades.
bar.wildShapeEmpty: No Wild Shape changes left this combat — they refresh next fight.
bar.wildShape: Bonus action: shed the body for a beast's shape — gain its vitality as temporary HP and rend with claws for several rounds. Once or twice per combat.
